## Andrea Carcano

CEO and Co-founder

Andrea is an expert and international leader in industrial network security, artificial intelligence and machine learning. He co-founded Nozomi Networks in 2013 with the goal of delivering a next-generation cybersecurity and operational visibility solution for industrial control networks.As CEO, Andrea is focused on extending Nozomi’s global dominance in innovation and technical leadership in an era defined by AI. Chief Technology Officer and Co-founder

results.title: Nozomi Networks Enters Next Phase of Growth as Mitsubishi Electric Completes Acquisition
results.content:
‍

> “Mitsubishi Electric acquired Nozomi Networks for the same reasons our customers trust us every day,” said Nozomi Networks CEO Edgard Capdevielle. “We have a proven track record of innovation and industry leadership and a unique vendor-agnostic approach that is a critical ingredient to our success. We will continue to advance the highest levels of quality and excellence in our platform and relationships that we always have moving forward as an independent subsidiary of Mitsubishi Electric, and we’re excited about the opportunities this brings.”

‍ [...] ‍

> “This acquisition brings us into a new era of innovation. It positions us to better serve our customers globally and meet the needs of an early majority market and the challenges of a rapidly evolving OT/IoT cybersecurity landscape,” said Nozomi Networks Co-founder and Chief Product Officer Andrea Carcano. “Nozomi is solidly positioned to extend its stature as the leader in OT/IoT cybersecurity. There is much more ahead for us, with game changing new innovations coming in 2026. We look forward to working with our customers and partners to deliver the best possible solution.”

‍ [...] San Francisco, CA – January 28, 2026 – Nozomi Networks, the leader in OT, IoT and cyber‑physical system security, today announced that Mitsubishi Electric Corporation (TOKYO: 6503) has completed its acquisition of the company. Originally announced on September 9, the transaction marks the start of a new phase of growth for Nozomi Networks while preserving the company’s independent operations, vendor‑neutral technology roadmap, and established go‑to‑market partnerships. As a wholly owned subsidiary, Nozomi Networks will continue to support the full OT/ICS ecosystem with the same open, multi‑vendor approach that has made it a trusted partner to critical infrastructure operators worldwide.

### Edgard Capdevielle

Former CEO, Nozomi Networks

Edgard brings an extensive background in successfully managing and expanding markets for both start-ups and established technology companies to his role as CEO. Previously he was Vice President of Product Management and Marketing for Imperva, where he led teams that made the company’s web and data security products leaders in their space. Prior to that he was a key executive at storage companies Data Domain and EMC.

results.content:
by

March 16, 2026

For the second year in a row, Nozomi Networks has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for CPS Protection Platforms. Nozomi is honored to be one of only four vendors recognized as a Leader across a total of 13 vendors evaluated. Nozomi is highest in this year’s quadrant for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. Nozomi Networks also received the highest scores of all vendors in all four Use Cases in the companion 2026 Gartner® Critical Capabilities for CPS Protection Platforms. [...] ## Key Takeaways

 Nozomi Networks was named a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant 2026 for CPS Protection Platforms, ranking highest for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute.
 In the 2026 Gartner Critical Capabilities report, Nozomi received the highest scores across all four CPS security use cases evaluated.
 The recognition highlights the strength of Nozomi’s AI-powered platform, which protects OT and IoT environments across more than 115 million assets and 12,000 deployments worldwide.

Nozomi's platform is purpose-built for the unique demands of OT and IoT environments, where legacy infrastructure, safety requirements, and operational continuity constraints make standard IT security approaches insufficient.
